files.README.md:
# mongoose-mongodb-from-documents

Data access layer generated by [DB2CRUD](https://github.com/RaulEstevezA/DB2CRUD) for a database that already exists: entities, repositories and services with Mongoose 8. It does not create or migrate the database.

## Settings

- Database: mongodb; code: asynchronous (every method returns a Promise).
- Entities: written for the tables the input had no class for.
- Services: take and return the entities.
- Transactions: every repository write is committed at once.
- Lists: lists return pages by offset and limit.

## Layout

```text
src/models.ts          the Mongoose models, as the database has the documents
src/database.ts        the database: DATABASE_URL, its connection and models
src/errors.ts          NotFoundError, ConflictError, ValidationFailedError: no HTTP codes
src/unit-of-work.ts    the repositories of every table, and the transaction of each operation
src/entities/          one entity per table
src/repositories/      one repository per table
src/services/          one service per table
test/                  repositories against a database, services on the in-memory repositories
crud-contract.json     what was written, for CRUD2Controller
```

## Running the tests

```bash
npm install
npm run typecheck && npm run build
TEST_DATABASE_URL=mongodb://localhost:27017/app npm test   # a real, disposable database: it is emptied
```

Look for `TODO` in the code: each one marks a decision the input did not settle.

  name!: string

  age!: number | null

  balance!: string | null

  visits!: number | null

  rate!: number

  active!: boolean

  address!: { street: string; city: string; 'zip code'?: string | null }

  tags!: string[]

  seen!: Date | null

  ref!: string | null

  photo!: Buffer | null

  scores!: unknown | null

  mixed!: unknown | null

  nothing!: unknown | null

  empty!: unknown[] | null

  deletedAt!: Date | null
}
